place.region: Antofagasta Region (Cerro Toco, near San Pedro de Atacama)

summary.plain: The high-altitude site near the summit of Cerro Toco in northern Chile that holds the Simons Observatory: one six-metre Large Aperture Telescope and three Small Aperture Telescopes, with their laboratories and a solar power plant.
summary.technical: Simons Observatory site near the summit of Cerro Toco, Atacama Desert, 5190 m, hosted in the Parque Astronómico Atacama about one hour by road from San Pedro de Atacama.
